title: MRMP-N: regularized polynomial regression of MODIS net photosynthesis across the Atlantic Forest, Cerrado and Caatinga of Bahia, Brazil (2001-2025)
description: Manuscript sources, model code (Python) and monthly database (2001-2025) of the MRMP-N, a degree-2 polynomial Ridge regression of MODIS net photosynthesis for the three biomes of Bahia State, Brazil.
